scripts.convex:domain-test: rm -rf .tmp/convex-domain && tsc --outDir .tmp/convex-domain --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --moduleResolution Node --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 --strict --skipLibCheck convex/match/*.ts convex/protocol/*.ts && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.tmp/convex-domain/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))" && node --test convex/match/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.ladder:test: rm -rf .tmp/ladder-test && tsc --outDir .tmp/ladder-test --target ES2022 --module CommonJS --moduleResolution Node --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 --strict --skipLibCheck shared/ladder/placement.ts shared/ladder/qa.ts shared/ladder/matchmaking.ts web/src/ladder/ladder.types.ts web/src/ladder/ladder.logic.ts && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.tmp/ladder-test/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))" && node --test web/src/ladder/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.phase0:test: npm run convex:typecheck && npm run convex:domain-test && npm run ladder:test && (cd web && npm run build) && luajit play/game/model/test_runner.lua
